The '''Sormahil system''' was located in the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> was a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="New Territories" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of [[Sormahil fire gem]]s.<ref name="Specter">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Sormahil fire gem]]s|system=Sormahil [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Sormahil [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square P-3.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
